description: Click an element via DOM .click() by CSS selector. Mutating. Works without the debugger — including on pages where CDP attach fails — but only fires the click handler, with no hover/focus/mousedown chain. If the page ignores it (custom dropdowns, canvas UI), use browser_computer left_click for a real mouse event.

selector.description: CSS selector of the element to click (first match)

tabId.description: tab id from browser_tabs_list or browser_tab_create

name: browser_click
